Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in the very first step by incorrectly identifying the director of *The Trial of Joan of Arc* as Robert Bresson. The 1962 film *The Trial of Joan of Arc* was directed by Otto Preminger, not Robert Bresson. This error led the entire chain of reasoning to compare the death dates of Franco Rossi (correctly identified) and Robert Bresson (incorrectly linked to the film), resulting in a wrong conclusion. While Robert Bresson did direct a famous *Joan of Arc* film (1928), the specific title provided (*The Trial of Joan of Arc*) refers to the 1962 Preminger film.
